title: fix(drilling): Drill, Bore and Thread take a start and an exit pick as the hole order
body:
## What changed

- Drill, Bore and Thread (mill) take a start pick and an exit pick. Their pick capability is `PickCapability::HoleOrder`.
- The hole under the start pick is cut first. The hole under the exit pick is cut last.
- The holes between keep the list order, rotated to the start hole. Example, list A B C D: start C gives C D A B. Exit B gives A C D B. Start C with exit D gives C A B D.
- A pick is on a hole when it is inside the circle of the hole. The nearer centre wins when two circles hold the pick.
- With no pick, the hole list is not changed. Each program without a pick is byte-identical.
- These picks are refused by name. No pick is moved to a different hole.
  - A pick that is on no hole: `Drill: the start point (40.000, 30.000) is not on a hole of this operation - ...`.
  - A start pick and an exit pick on the same hole, when the list has more than one hole.
  - A pick on a Drill with cross holes.
  - A pick on a lathe's axial Drill (refused in the generator, because it needs the machine).
- The operation page of the three kinds has typed rows: "First hole stated", "First hole X / Y", "Last hole stated", "Last hole X / Y". A group that is switched on seeds the first (or the last) hole of the list.
- The schema text of MCP `edit_operation` names the three kinds. `list_operation_types` answers `start_exit: { start: true, exit: true, field: "picks" }` for them.
- Probe is not changed. Its row says "Not taken - a probe touches the part and cuts no path".

## Cause

`KindInfo::pick()` answered `NotTaken(PICK_OWED)` for Drill, Bore and Thread. The door refused each pick. The three arms of `generate` gave the hole list to the kernel in the list order (`drilling::drill`, `machining2d::bore_started`, `machining2d::thread_mill`). A direct `operation::generate` call ignored the picks without a note.

## Design

The issue and #3324 name the capability, the refusals and the example rule "the list order, rotated to the start". Where they are silent, I took the smallest change:

- "Near a hole" is "inside the circle of the hole". A search distance is not used.
- The rule is one function, `camcraft_motion::drilling::hole_order` (new module `drilling/order.rs`). The three arms of `generate` put the hole list in that order before the kernel reads it. The three kernels are not changed.
- The lathe's axial and cross holes refuse a pick. No XY order exists there.
- The picks ride the existing `EditOperationParams` and the existing `picks` field of #3339. No new command and no new file key.
- The decision file is `docs/decisions/3328-drilling-hole-order.md`.

## Tests

Pins (all red before the fix, on unchanged `upstream/main` code at `ddee3aed6`):

- `start_exit_shared::hole_order::drill_cuts_the_picked_first_hole_and_last_hole` (golden `hole_order_drill.cl`)
- `start_exit_shared::hole_order::bore_cuts_the_picked_first_hole_and_last_hole` (golden `hole_order_bore.cl`)
- `start_exit_shared::hole_order::thread_cuts_the_picked_first_hole_and_last_hole_and_undo_restores_the_order` (golden `hole_order_thread.cl`; undo and redo of `EditOperationParams`)
- `start_exit_shared::hole_order::a_pick_that_is_not_on_a_hole_is_refused_by_name` (the three kinds; the door and the generator; two picks on one hole)
- `start_exit_shared::hole_order::a_pick_on_a_drill_with_cross_holes_is_refused_by_name`
- `start_exit_shared::hole_order::mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_hole_order_picks_and_undo_clears_them`
- `drilling_axial::a_start_or_exit_pick_on_the_axial_hole_refuses_by_name`
- `camcraft-ui` lib: `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::the_hole_kinds_type_their_first_and_last_hole`
- `camcraft-motion` lib: `drilling::order::tests::*` (4 tests of the rule)

Red before the fix: the six `hole_order` pins failed. The order pins read `[20, 60, 100, 140]` (the list order). The other pins read `Drill: a start point is not taken - the planner chooses the entry and the exit of this kind until its slice of #1448 ships`.

Mutation results (old code back, pin run, fix restored):

| Mutation | Red pins |
|---|---|
| `generate.rs` from `upstream/main` | `drill_cuts_...`, `bore_cuts_...`, `thread_cuts_...`, `a_pick_that_is_not_on_a_hole_...` (the generator check), `a_start_or_exit_pick_on_the_axial_hole_...` |
| `pick_kinds.rs`: the door check `hole_order().err()` removed, the cross-hole guard off | `a_pick_that_is_not_on_a_hole_...`, `a_pick_on_a_drill_with_cross_holes_...`, `mcp_edit_operation_sets_...` |
| `op_page.rs` from `upstream/main` | `the_hole_kinds_type_their_first_and_last_hole` |

All pins are green with the fix restored.

Expected-change test: `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` pinned "only the contour and the wire take a pick". It now names the three hole kinds as `HoleOrder`.

Gates on head `5ad46c819` (base `ddee3aed6`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 771 steps, 770 ok, 1 failed, 0 stalled, 89.8 min. The red step is `app suites: cadmpeg_import` (`stub::a_hung_program_is_stopped_at_the_time_limit_and_its_folder_removed`). It is a time-limit test and this diff does not reach it. I ran `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test cadmpeg_import` alone after the gate: 13 passed, 0 failed.
- The quick plan included `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl` and `solid_law_goldens`: all ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 11.8 min (release).

## Before and after UI screenshots

The page is the operation page on the tab that holds the Start point and Exit point groups. That tab is Geometry for Drill and Thread. It is "Lead in / Lead out" for Bore.

| Kind | Before (`ddee3aed6`, the merge base) | After (`5ad46c819`), groups off | After (`5ad46c819`), groups on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drill | ![Drill before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/before-drill.png) | ![Drill after, groups off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/after-drill-off.png) | ![Drill after, groups on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/after-drill-on.png) |
| Bore | ![Bore before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/before-bore.png) | ![Bore after, groups off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/after-bore-off.png) | ![Bore after, groups on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/after-bore-on.png) |
| Thread | ![Thread before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/before-thread.png) | ![Thread after, groups off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/after-thread-off.png) | ![Thread after, groups on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761/pr-3970/after-thread-on.png) |

- Before: each group shows only the line "Not taken - the planner chooses the entry and the exit of this kind until its slice of #1448 ships".
- After, groups off: each group shows one check box, "First hole stated" or "Last hole stated". The "Not taken" line is gone.
- After, groups on: each group shows its X row, its Y row and its consequence line. The fixture has holes at X -10, 0 and 10. The first group seeds X -10. The last group seeds X 10.
- The images are only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, at `eff3818dd9bf6e57b1a5764387806e6deb015761`, in the folder `pr-3970/`. No image is in this PR branch.
- A temporary headless test rendered the real page code (`pages::properties`, `egui_kittest`, wgpu) at each commit. It used the fixture of the pin `the_hole_kinds_type_their_first_and_last_hole`. The test is not committed.
- The header line "Type: Face" comes from that fixture. The committed operation is a Face and the hole kind is in the draft, because the fixture holds an end mill only.
- Each image is the top 800 px of the 620 x 1400 px render.

## Goldens moved

None moved. `git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` shows three new files and no changed file:

- `crates/app/tests/golden/hole_order_drill.cl` (new: start C, exit D of four holes)
- `crates/app/tests/golden/hole_order_bore.cl` (new: start B, exit A of four holes)
- `crates/app/tests/golden/hole_order_thread.cl` (new: start the middle hole, exit the first hole of three)

## Not exercised

- The full heavy lanes were not run. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches 107 release steps. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556) gives a `P2` PR no heavy step. The light lane ran instead.
- The viewport pick does not snap to a hole yet. Follow-up: #3960. Until then the rows are typed, or MCP sets the picks.
- A posted NC program with picks was not made. The cycle records of the Drill golden (`; CYCLE` lines) are in the picked order, and the post reads those records.
- The first traverse law was not pinned again. It reads the generated path, and the Drill pin asserts that the path starts over the picked first hole.
- A tilted (3+2) Drill with picks was not tested.
- `upstream/main` moved by 18 commits during the gate. `git merge-tree` of this head with the new main is clean. The branch was not refreshed.

## Overlaps

- #3832 (draft) and #3103 (draft, `conflicts`) change the Bore arm of `run_job_arms` in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`. They change the destructure list and the `BoreParams` fields. This PR adds one statement before the `bore_started` call. Different lines of the same arm: whichever merges second refreshes.
- #3899 (draft), #3674 and #3251 change other arms of `generate.rs`.

Changelog: Drill, Bore and Thread (mill) take a start point and an exit point as the hole order: the picked hole is cut first or last, and a point that is on no hole is refused by name.

Effort: high

Fixes #3328
